(Japanese: '''モリじい''' ''Old Man Mori'') is a character in [[Pocket Monsters XY: The Legend of the Pokémon Dragon King]]. He debuted in [[LDK0]]. He is an old man who guided {{OBP|Koji|LDK}} and {{OBP|Akira|LDK}} to Mega Evolution.
